SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.name AS league_name,aliases.keys AS league_keys,
 totals.matches_count AS match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version
 AND ($1::bigint IS NOT NULL OR p.published_to_gen IS NULL) LIMIT 1) published ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key) keys FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=e.competition_id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
LEFT JOIN analytics.competition_summary totals ON totals.build_id=b.id AND totals.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
WHERE b.status='ready' AND ($1::bigint IS NULL OR b.id=$1::bigint)
ORDER BY e.season_key DESC,b.competition_season_id,b.id LIMIT 2049

 FROM ingest.match_coverage c WHERE c.match_id=s.match_id AND c.feature_code='shots' AND c.is_canonical

 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id

 AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted

/*orion:shots*/ WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
 build_id bigint,edition_id bigint,dg bigint,cg bigint,league_id text,league_name text,season text,token text))
 SELECT s.external_shot_id,s.player_id,s.period_code,s.minute,s.minute_added,s.x_m,s.y_m,
 s.coordinate_frame,s.pitch_length_m,s.pitch_width_m,s.xg,s.xgot,s.source_event_type,s.source_shot_type,
 s.is_goal,s.is_own_goal,s.is_on_target,s.outcome,s.body_part,s.situation,
 p.sequence_no AS period_order,pa.public_key AS player_public_id,pp.display_name AS player_name,
 pp.candidates AS player_profile_candidates,
 ta.public_key AS team_public_id
 FROM x JOIN football.shots s ON s.match_id=$2::bigint AND s.source_id=$3::bigint AND s.variant_key=$4
 AND s.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted
 JOIN football.match_teams mt ON mt.match_id=s.match_id AND mt.team_id=s.team_id AND mt.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (mt.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<mt.recorded_to_gen) AND mt.is_canonical AND NOT mt.is_deleted
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN football.periods p ON p.code=s.period_code AND p.definition_version=s.period_definition_version AND p.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<p.recorded_to_gen)
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.public_key FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='player' AND a.player_id=s.player_id
 AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted AND a.public_key ~ '^p_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' ORDER BY a.public_key LIMIT 1) pa ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT p.display_name,CASE p.profile_context WHEN 'provider_global' THEN 0
      WHEN 'legacy_normalized_global' THEN 1 WHEN 'global' THEN 2 END AS priority
    FROM football.player_profile_versions p WHERE p.player_id=s.player_id AND p.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<p.recorded_to_gen) AND p.is_canonical AND NOT p.is_deleted
    AND ((p.profile_context='provider_global' AND p.variant_key='provider:exact' AND p.source_id=s.source_id)
      OR (p.profile_context='legacy_normalized_global' AND p.source_id=s.source_id)
      OR (p.profile_context='global' AND p.provenance_kind='manual' AND p.source_id IS NULL)))
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS candidates,
    CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN min(display_name) END AS display_name
  FROM candidates WHERE priority=(SELECT min(priority) FROM candidates)) pp ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.public_key FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=s.team_id
 AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' ORDER BY a.public_key LIMIT 1) ta ON true
 ORDER BY p.sequence_no NULLS LAST,s.source_ordinal NULLS LAST,s.external_shot_id,s.revision_id LIMIT 1001

 FROM analytics.match_summary s
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id
  AND m.competition_season_id=$2::bigint AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=$3::bigint AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR $3::bigint<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 JOIN ingest.public_aliases a ON a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=s.match_id
  AND a.public_key=$5::text AND a.recorded_from_gen<=$4::bigint AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR $4::bigint<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted

    WHERE witness.revision_id=a.match_revision_id AND witness.id=a.match_id
      AND witness.competition_season_id=s.competition_season_id))
 LEFT JOIN ingest.match_coverage c ON c.match_id=s.match_id AND c.feature_code='shots'
  AND c.is_canonical AND c.recorded_from_gen<=$3::bigint AND (c.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR $3::bigint<c.recorded_to_gen)
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT min(mp.player_id)::text player_id,count(*)::int member_count,bool_and(mp.played IS TRUE) played

     AND mp.recorded_from_gen<=$3::bigint AND (mp.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR $3::bigint<mp.recorded_to_gen) AND mp.is_canonical AND NOT mp.is_deleted
   WHERE $7::text='player' AND a.route_kind='player' AND a.public_key=$6::text
     AND a.recorded_from_gen<=$4::bigint AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR $4::bigint<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted

 FROM analytics.match_summary s
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id
  AND m.competition_season_id=$2::bigint AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=$3::bigint AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR $3::bigint<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted

    WHERE witness.revision_id=a.match_revision_id AND witness.id=a.match_id
      AND witness.competition_season_id=s.competition_season_id))
 LEFT JOIN ingest.match_coverage c ON c.match_id=s.match_id AND c.feature_code='shots'
  AND c.is_canonical AND c.recorded_from_gen<=$3::bigint AND (c.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR $3::bigint<c.recorded_to_gen)
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT min(mp.player_id)::text player_id,count(*)::int member_count,bool_and(mp.played IS TRUE) played

 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(*)::int total_count,coalesce(bool_or(r.player_id IS NULL),false) unknown_shooter,
